name: Open Targets Platform
summary: Drug target evidence: target-disease associations, target tractability and genetic constraint, diseases, drugs and their mechanisms, through one GraphQL API.
notes: Keyless. GraphQL only: one POST taking query and variables; ask only for the fields you need.

Root fields include target(ensemblId), disease(efoId), drug(chemblId), their plural forms, search(queryString, entityNames, page), mapIds(queryTerms, entityNames), variant(variantId) and study(studyId).
Find an id first with search (e.g. a gene symbol to its Ensembl id, a disease name to its EFO id), then query the entity.
For systematic work across many targets the project recommends its bulk downloads or BigQuery instead of many API calls.

endpoints.name: Run a GraphQL query
endpoints.summary: Any query over targets, diseases, drugs, variants, studies and their associations.

query.example: query target($ensemblId: String!) { target(ensemblId: $ensemblId) { id approvedSymbol } }
